## Deal submission checklist

Before requesting review, please confirm:

- [ ] **Official deal details:** Tool name, category, verified discount and dates, and an **official** deal or pricing URL from the vendor.
- [ ] **README table row:** New row matches the README’s 4-column format (`Tool | Description | Deal | Promo Code`) with a 2026 status tag (e.g. `**[2026 live]**`, `**[2026 upcoming]**`, `**[2026 TBA]**`, or `**[2026 ended]**`). Do not change existing rows, links, or `?ref=aitoolsfyi` parameters on other entries.
- [ ] **Links:** No URL shorteners or third-party affiliate links—vendor URLs only (as elsewhere in this list).
- [ ] Starred the repo to help more people discover these deals (appreciated, not required)

**Anything reviewers should know?** (optional verification notes, end dates, promo behavior at checkout, etc.)
